name: Zimri
bio: Zimri was the son of Salu, a leader of a Simeonite clan. When Israel fell under a plague from God for committing sexual immorality with Moabite women and worshiping Baal of Peor, Zimri brazenly brought the Midianite woman Cozbi into his tent in full view of Moses and the whole assembly; Phinehas, seeing this, took a spear and ran them both through, and the plague was stopped (Numbers 25:6-8, 14). Zimri's name and deed stand in Scripture as a stark symbol of open rebellion and disregard for God's demand for holiness.
